name: Lodash Data Pipeline Visualizer
summary: Interactive data transformation pipeline CodeComponent that visualizes lodash operations step-by-step on employee records. Features a raw data Table with 20 employees, then seven transformation steps in an Accordion: _.groupBy(dept), _.sortBy(salary), _.filter(rating > 3), _.map for label transform, _.reduce/_.meanBy/_.sumBy for aggregated department stats, _.uniqBy(dept) for unique departments, and _.chunk(5) for pagination. Includes debounced search Input filtering. Uses Table, Accordion, Card, Badge, Input, and Icons from the SDK.
shortSummary: Interactive lodash transformation pipeline visualizing groupBy, sortBy, filter, map, reduce, uniqBy, and chunk
